title: CompassTracker
description: A simple and lightweight plugin that turns a compass into a player tracker. It points to the nearest player and shows the distance if they are within 50 blocks. Perfect for PvP and survival servers.
body: A lightweight Minecraft plugin that turns a compass into a player tracking tool. It automatically points to the nearest player and displays the distance if they are within 50 blocks. Perfect for PvP, survival, and mini-game servers. Simple to use, optimized, and requires no setup.
